title: @inth/sdk: consent SDK for JavaScript and script tags
description: The consent engine, the vanilla JavaScript client, the script-tag builds, UI styles, translations and IAB TCF support. Framework packages such as `@inth/react` and `@inth/vue` build on it. Install it directly for a site without a UI framework, or to load the script-tag build from a CDN.
prerequisites: Node.js 20.19 or later for a bundled app
An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), or `testing()` for development and tests
usage: Start the client with the project URL from your Inth project
For a site without a build step, load `lib/browser/dist/inth.js` from a CDN instead. See the [script tag quickstart](https://inth.com/docs/frameworks/html/quickstart)
For the full setup, see the [JavaScript quickstart](https://inth.com/docs/frameworks/javascript/quickstart)
